posts.author: enne24
posts.body: Hi everyone. I've downloaded the free trial for RPG maker VX Ace and it tells me that the 30 days free trial has expired. I assure you that I've never used it in my life and nobody has ever had access to my PC besides me, so I think there might be something wrong. Is there a way I can ask for help?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body: You could contact customer support where it says Support on the top of the page.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
several possibilities
one thing is that VXA needs the TLS2.1 protocol to connect to the DRM server for checking, and modern Windows versions have that protocol disabled by default.
check your windows internet options to enable that.
another possibility is that you might have had the demo installed on your computer before - VXAce is more than a decade old after all. In that case you can only contact support like you were told above.
Or it could be that you might have to run Ace in compatibility mode, especially if you are on Win11 (I don't know what changes were made in Win11, so I don't know if Ace can run without compatibility settings.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:

posts.body: Thanks for the help, I just bought it in the end since it's heavily discounted on steam right now. I've probably used it before, but just don't remember it
